en: Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-learner (*na-saññā-nidassana-appaṭigha-na-sekkha*), a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and learner (*anidassana-appaṭigha-sekkha*) arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-non-learner (*na-saññā-nidassana-appaṭigha-na-asekkha*), a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-non-learner (*anidassana-appaṭigha-asekkha*) arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and neither-learner-nor-not-learner (*na-saññā-nidassana-appaṭigha-na-neva-sekkha-na-asekkha*), a state that is visible and reacting (*sanidassana-sappaṭigha*)...
A state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner arises with root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root, twenty-one;
under predominance, twenty-one … pe … under non-disappearance, twenty-one.
